summary: Held through an early -8pt dip (t=1-2m) that partially recovered to -5.5pts (t=3m), consistent with normal noise. Bailed at t=4m when a fresh down-leg formed (20.2pt amplitude, only 1% giveback -- i.e. no bounce yet), PROPP and HA both fired against the position, and lambda_hat turned significantly positive (trend-continuation, not mean-reversion) on 5s/15s simultaneously, pushing local px to -15.75. That combo -- fresh strong leg + near-zero giveback + multi-TF trending lambda + two independent fire signals against -- read as a genuine breakdown rather than a dip. Next time I'd watch giveback% resetting near 0 on a NEW leg after an already-adverse move as the key tell, since a recovering leg (frame 3) showing rising giveback% is the opposite, healthy signature.
